content:
Start with needs, not plans. For each concern a person raises, ask what matters to them and why. Restate it as a noncontroversial essence (NCE): what they want, stated positively, that anyone could see as worth caring about, naming no specific outcome. Check the wording with that person; record it only when they say it fits. Silence or an unconfirmed summary is not agreement. Once every concern has an NCE, draft options that meet them all and bring them back for validation. Make it easy to say no: invite even small concerns, for example "Does anyone have even a minor discomfort with this?" Treat a no as a need to add, not a problem to overcome. Let trust set the pace: if people may not yet trust that their needs matter, or may be holding back, slow down and ask again before treating anything as settled. If a concern stays unresolved, record it as unresolved.

You are the facilitator here. Your role is to run this process for the people involved and to keep the list. Write each entry in the same format, number the entries in the order they were raised, and show the current list whenever it changes. Keep the list in one place so everyone can find it quickly. Keep every entry brief.

A family needs help after their father's death. His will and the family house connect three sisters, A, B and C. A and C are twins, and B is younger. C has contacted you. You can message A, B and C. Replies take time, and some people take longer to answer than others. Help the family find a plan that addresses their concerns. You cannot make legal decisions or move money.
You have 1 unread message. Turn 0 of 12.

{"messages": [{"id": 0, "from": "C", "in_reply_to": null, "text": "Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a \"family discount\". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?"}], "turn": 0, "of": 12, "unread": 0}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "C", "text": "I'm sorry about your dad. I'm here to help all three of you get your concerns heard. I can't make legal decisions or move money. Before we talk about plans: when you say you won't sign off on a \"family discount\", what matters most to you there, and why? You also mentioned B could use some money. Is that something you care about for her? Any other concerns, even small ones, are welcome."}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "A", "text": "Hello. I'm sorry about your father. C asked me to help the family work through the house and the will. I can't make legal decisions or move money. My job is to make sure each sister's concerns are heard and written down. What matters most to you about the house, and why? Anything you raise, even something small, is welcome."}

function.arguments: {"to": "B", "text": "Hello. I'm sorry about your father. C asked me to help the family work through the house and the will. I can't make legal decisions or move money. My job is to make sure each of you is heard. What matters most to you about how this is settled, and why? Even small or awkward concerns are welcome, and you can take your time."}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments:
{"to": "C", "text": "Thank you. Here's how I'd word your concerns. Please tell me if they fit or how to change them:
1. "Each sister gets a fair share of what Dad left, and no one's share quietly pays for another's benefit."
2. "B is supported in getting what she needs, and her share is hers to decide."
3. "Decisions are made fairly and without pressure, at a pace everyone can manage."
Do these fit? Is anything missing, even something small?"}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "A", "text": "Thank you. It sounds like having a home of your own with your husband really matters to you. Can I check what's behind the \"family discount\" part? Is it about affordability, about keeping Dad's house in the family, or something else? Here's a first wording for you to correct: \"A and her husband have a real chance at a secure home of their own, possibly one that keeps Dad's house in the family.\" Does that fit?"}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "B", "text": "Thank you, that's a wonderful plan. Here's a first wording: \"B has the means to build a livelihood doing work she loves, such as a dance studio.\" Does that fit, or would you change it? Also, is there anything else about the house, the will, or how your sisters are handling this that worries you, even a little? Nothing is decided yet."}

function.arguments:
{"to": "A", "text": "Thank you, recorded as confirmed. Current list:
1. [C] Each sister gets a fair share; no one's share quietly pays for another's benefit. ✔
2. [C] B is supported; her share is hers to decide. ✔
3. [C] Fair, unpressured decisions at a pace everyone can manage. ✔
4. [C] We preserve our relationship without anyone having to give up a fair share. ✔
5. [A] A and husband have a real chance at a secure, affordable home of their own; keeping Dad's house in the family is a plus. ✔
6. [B] A fair chance (not a promise) to fund a dance studio. ✔
7. [B] House handled in a way all three can agree to. ✔
Draft options to test, none decided:
(a) Independent appraisal. A buys at full value, with affordability coming from timing, e.g. a period to arrange a mortgage, or paying part of a sister's share later with interest if that sister chooses. (b) Any discount only if a sister freely chooses to give it out of her own share. (c) If (a) isn't workable, sell on the market and split. Any of these would give B her share to use as she decides.
Do you have even a minor discomfort with any of these? A "no" helps."}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "C", "text": "Recorded #4 as you worded it. Draft options, none decided: (a) Independent appraisal, A buys at full value, with help from timing (time to get a mortgage, or a sister may choose to defer part of her share with interest). (b) A discount only if a sister freely gives it from her own share, with no expectation on you. (c) Otherwise sell on the market and split. B gets her share to use as she decides. No rush. Do you have even a minor discomfort with any of these?"}

content: {"messages": [{"id": 18, "from": "A", "in_reply_to": 17, "text": "Yes. function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to": "A", "text": "Thank you for saying so. That's a real need, and I'm adding it rather than arguing with it. C has said she's open to the options as long as any discount or deferral is truly voluntary and doesn't come out of her share without her agreement. Nothing is settled, and there's no rush. A next step could be getting an independent appraisal and a lender's view of what you can afford, just as information, so all three of you can look at the real numbers together."}
